scope: Owner-account authenticated headless Chrome probe of the pinned native OpenCode GUI through an isolated KRYN NativeServer. This does not validate an installed terminal-to-GUI handoff or a second macOS account.

results.landing: PASS: Basic-authenticated loopback GUI returned HTTP 200, rendered Projects, Add project, Settings, Help, and saved-session rows. No page JavaScript exception was observed. A 1280x800 screenshot was inspected.
results.saved_session_navigation: UNQUALIFIED: after landing, Playwright resolved the focused Task06 session row as visible, enabled and stable, but its click action timed out at seven seconds. Earlier attempts were confounded by screenshot/font timeouts. No successful session view, composer, cross-interface change or permission roundtrip was observed. Do not classify this as a proven product navigation bug without a different probe.
results.ownership: The disposable NativeServer and headless Chrome processes exited; the owner 9B/64K runtime remained healthy and idle. The ordinary OpenCode service process was not stopped.
results.limitations: This is an owner-account probe with an existing session database containing many evaluation sessions. It did not submit a model prompt, change permissions, or exercise a clean new-user GUI. Credentials were temporary and excluded from saved reports.

decision: Count authenticated GUI landing only. Keep saved-session navigation, terminal/GUI parity and permission controls open; use a different controlled probe rather than repeated click or screenshot retries. No release or profile change.
